# Run brief: a longer wait for the weather services

## Goal
- Geocoding and weather requests in `workflows/weather/scripts/run.py` wait up to 20 seconds for an answer instead of 10, since the geocoding service is sometimes slow to reply.

## Constraints
- Standard library only.
- UK English, with no em or en dashes and no smart quotes.

## Out of scope
- Every other part of the weather report.

## Acceptance checks
- python -m py_compile workflows/weather/scripts/run.py

## Edit paths
- workflows/weather/ | Measure: git ls-files workflows/weather/

## Open questions
None

## Source
- `workflows/weather/scripts/run.py`
